title: Acute focal neurologic deficit (suspected stroke)
population: Adults (the 2026 guideline also adds pediatric guidance, not encoded here)

layer0.label: Complaint
layer0.detail: Sudden weakness, numbness, speech or vision loss.

layer0.label: Timing
layer0.detail: Time last known well decides treatment eligibility.

layer0.label: Bedside glucose
layer0.detail: Checked before thrombolysis; severe hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia can mimic stroke.

gate.label: Within a treatment window
gate.detail: Stroke pathway immediately; brain imaging within 25 minutes; other tests must not delay reperfusion.

gate.label: Outside known windows
gate.detail: Still image urgently; the 2026 guideline widens some windows with perfusion imaging.

gate_note: Verified against the 2026 AHA/ASA guideline, which replaced the 2018 guideline and 2019 update.

steps.title: Bedside glucose
steps.description: Detects and urgently corrects severe hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia.

hypo.text: Normal glucose, or a disabling deficit that persists after correction, means glucose does not explain the deficit.

steps.title: Brain imaging: noncontrast CT or MRI
steps.description: Assesses ischemic burden and excludes hemorrhage before any reperfusion treatment (class 1, level A).

ich.text: Imaging without hemorrhage excludes intracranial hemorrhage before reperfusion.

ais.text: Mild to moderate early ischemic change neither precludes nor delays thrombolysis.

steps.title: ECG and troponin
steps.description: Recommended, but must not delay treatment.

ais.text: Baseline ECG and troponin must not delay IV thrombolysis or thrombectomy.

steps.title: Vascular and perfusion imaging
steps.timing: Suspected large vessel occlusion within 24 hours; extended windows
steps.description: CT/CTA or MRI/MRA as fast as possible for thrombectomy selection.

ais.text: Perfusion imaging can select some unknown-onset patients for thrombolysis up to 9 hours.

eliminate_when.text: A disabling deficit persisting after glucose correction; thrombolysis is still recommended then.
Noncontrast CT or MRI without hemorrhage.

do_not_rely.text: Delaying treatment for ECG, troponin or advanced imaging.
Mild early ischemic change on CT as a reason to withhold thrombolysis.

ais.no_rule_note: Stroke is confirmed or treated, not eliminated, in this route.

mimic.no_rule_note: Seizure, migraine and other mimics not sourced.

gaps.title: Pediatric stroke
gaps.text: The 2026 guideline adds pediatric recommendations, not encoded here.

gaps.title: Other mimics
gaps.text: Mimics other than glucose disorders are not sourced.
